cohort: The study included 2783 women who experienced an operative second-stage birth (operative vaginal birth or fully dilated caesarean) across four hospitals in Melbourne, Australia, with 402 respondents to the survey.
finding: Prolonged second stage, anal sphincter injury, and postpartum haemorrhage were associated with a negative birth experience, while maternal age greater than 35 years and vacuum-assisted birth were protective.
mod_finding: Vacuum-assisted birth was found to be protective against a negative birth experience (OR 0.42, 95% CI 0.22-0.77, p = 0.006).
cross-section timing: Birth experience was assessed for women undergoing operative second-stage birth between July 2023 and March 2025.
